questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of a load balancer?
options: Distribute incoming requests across several servers
questions.explanation: It spreads traffic to improve availability and throughput.

questions.prompt: Which technique keeps frequently read data in fast storage to reduce latency?
questions.explanation: A cache serves repeated reads without hitting the slower source.

options: Adding more CPU or RAM to one machine
questions.explanation: Horizontal scaling adds nodes; vertical scaling enlarges a single node.

questions.prompt: During a network partition, the CAP theorem says a distributed data store must choose between:
questions.explanation: When partitions occur you cannot have both strict consistency and full availability.
